newsitem.title: USA: Gables Residential sells prfrd shares.
newsitem.headline: Gables Residential sells prfrd shares.

text.p: Gables Residential Trust said on Thursday it has sold in a public offering 4.6 million shares of 8.30 percent series A cumulative redeemable preferred shares at $25.00 per share.

The preferred stock, which may be redeemed by the Company at $25.00 per share on or after July 24, 2002, has no stated maturity, sinking fund or mandatory redemption and is not convertible into any other securities of the company.
Net proceeds to the company from this offering, after anticipated issuance costs, are estimated to be approximately $111.2 million, the company said.
Proceeds will be used to reduce borrowings under its credit facilities, Gables said in a statement.
The offering was managed by PaineWebber Inc and Smith Barney Inc.
